### CI

CI on this repo requires manual triggering by a maintainer. Once you've opened this PR, ping a maintainer or leave a comment asking them to run CI.

A maintainer can start CI by commenting:

> run tests

And cancel it by commenting:

> cancel ci

Results will appear in the [Actions tab](../../actions) and a link will be posted back to this PR.
